rationale: The portfolio makes inhabited systems a concrete explanation of Jamie's professional practice. Photographs, dated traces, public sources and explicitly reconstructed workflows make this more than a statement of values. The role remains legible throughout.

The section The system lives between the screen and the room joins a dated facilitation photograph to a campaign interface and a plain account of entering, understanding, deciding and continuing.

Systems people can inhabit joins artistic, civic, technical and social practice in plain language, states the operating sequence, and links directly to projects. Open House is one bounded lineage paragraph with participant governance and many-perspective documentation, not an artist biography or faculty testimonial.

Actually followed home to About to WOWList at both widths. Desktop required two link clicks. Mobile required opening Menu plus those two links; the lineage surface itself was reached within two interactions.

Open House's active projection is supported by the June 28, 2006 public article record and separate initiation/collective-governance relations. The public-safe source note excludes protected educational-record text and the unapproved recommendation. No raw article, private evaluation text or faculty praise appeared on reviewed rendered routes.

Project-photo records identify courtesy credits and portfolio authorization, while production/indexing states remain separate.
